text:
mia-sales: Heads-up: Citrine Retail wants a 2-week POC starting next Tues. Core ask: live receipt ingestion -> streaming structured JSON + a tool call to enrich SKUs. They asked for a short SDK drop-in sample and a ballpark hosted vs dedicated cost for ~40k tokens/day. Any fast blockers?

sophia-citrine: Quick note from Citrine eng: we need per-request audit_id propagated, and customer wants to see an example webhook for function outputs. Latency target: 250ms for bulk path, 120ms for single-item lookups.

ryan-presales: Noted. For hosted POC we recommend low-latency mode (disable batching) and a trimmed context model. Will draft a Python streaming + function-call example.

omar-se: Python sample (streaming + function call):
```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
stream = client.chat.stream(
  model='redwood-micro-1',
  messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Analyze receipt image -> json"}],
  functions=[{"name":"enrich_sku","description":"map sku to catalog"}],
  structured_output={"format":"json_schema","schema_id":"receipt_v2"}
)
for event in stream:
  if event.type=='delta':
    print(event.delta, end='')
  elif event.type=='function_call':
    # call local enrich service
    handle_tool(event.payload)
```

mia-sales: Nice. Can we also include a tiny webhook example for their infra? They asked to see how function outputs land in their service.

omar-se: Webhook example (pseudo):
```json
POST /hooks/receive
{ "audit_id":"1234","tool":"enrich_sku","result":{"sku":"X123","desc":"Blue tee","price":19.99} }
```

tara-sec: Security items: Citrine requires SOC2 + IP allowlist + SAML SSO for non-prod. For the POC, enable IP allowlist + scoped API key + short TTL tokens. For production recommend Dedicated or Private with KMS. I'll attach the checklist to the calendar invite.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Ticket RDW-5555 opened to provision a low-latency hosted slot. ETA ~36h.

sophia-citrine: Also: legal wants sample SAR/audit log with api_key redaction. Can you provide snippet?

omar-se: Example audit log line (redacted):
`{"ts":"2026-02-10T15:03:21Z","route":"/chat/stream","audit_id":"1234","api_key":"REDACTED","in_bytes":2048,"out_tokens":124}`

ryan-presales: Pricing back-of-envelope: 40k tokens/day ~= 1.2M tokens/mo. Hosted (list) ~ $0.00028/token -> ~$336/mo. If they need sustained 120-250ms SLOs at scale, Dedicated starts around $2k-4k/mo depending on GPU config; I'll get an exact quote and possible volume discounts.

mia-sales: Can we book a tech sync Fri 9am PT with Citrine eng + security? Invite will include pre-call checklist and our POC repo link.
